Infer replication states of one cell

Source: R/hmm.R
infer_single_cell_states.Rd

Infer per-window replication states (2 = unreplicated, 4 = replicated) of a single cell from read counts in G1-derived windows, following the steps of the original MATLAB-derived pipeline:

Usage

infer_single_cell_states(
  counts,
  breakpoints,
  autocorr_aggr_width = 15L,
  autocorr_threshold = 0.2,
  cnv_aggr_width = 15L,
  cnv_fc_cutoff = 1.5,
  cnv_fdr_cutoff = 0.01,
  min_segment_length = 2L,
  hmm_aggr_width = 10L,
  init_ratio_lower = 1.5,
  init_ratio_upper = 2.5,
  min_switch_prob = 1e-04,
  tolerance = 1e-06,
  maxiter = 500L,
  final_ratio_lower = 1.5,
  final_ratio_upper = 2.2
)

Arguments

counts

Numeric vector of read counts per window (names are kept).

breakpoints

Numeric vector of 1-based indices where a new chromosome starts.

autocorr_aggr_width

Aggregation width (windows) for the autocorrelation filter.

autocorr_threshold

Maximum lag-20 autocorrelation.

cnv_aggr_width

Aggregation width for CNV filtering.

cnv_fc_cutoff

Minimum fold change of a CNV segment (must be > 1).

cnv_fdr_cutoff

FDR cutoff for CNV segments, in (0, 1).

min_segment_length

Minimum segment length (aggregated windows) for CNV segmentation (must be >= 2).

hmm_aggr_width

Aggregation width for HMM initialisation.

init_ratio_lower, init_ratio_upper

Accepted range of the ratio of the two initial Poisson means.

min_switch_prob

Minimum state-switch probability in [0, 0.5).

tolerance

Convergence tolerance of Baum-Welch.

maxiter

Maximum number of Baum-Welch iterations.

final_ratio_lower, final_ratio_upper

Accepted range of the final state-4 / state-2 read-depth ratio.

Value

A list with filtered_counts (numeric, NaN at missing or CNV-masked windows) and states (numeric, 2, 4 or NA), both of length length(counts).

Details

  1. CNV filtering: counts are aggregated by cnv_aggr_width windows; two-change-point segmentation (linear statistic, BIC penalty) plus Poisson tests (BH-adjusted) iteratively mask segments whose mean differs from the background by at least cnv_fc_cutoff-fold with FDR below cnv_fdr_cutoff. Masked windows become NaN in filtered_counts.

  2. Autocorrelation filter: if the lag-20 autocorrelation of counts aggregated by autocorr_aggr_width exceeds autocorr_threshold, all states are NA.

  3. Initialisation: a two-component Poisson mixture on counts aggregated by hmm_aggr_width; if the ratio of the two means is outside [init_ratio_lower, init_ratio_upper], all states are set to 2.

  4. Baum-Welch training (up to maxiter iterations, convergence tolerance tolerance, switch probabilities at least min_switch_prob); a cell that does not converge gets all states NA.

  5. Viterbi decoding, restarting at breakpoints (chromosome starts).

  6. Post-filter: if the mean-count ratio between state-4 and state-2 segments is outside [final_ratio_lower, final_ratio_upper], all states are NA.

See also

assign_replication_states() to run this over all cells.
